$comment: workhub-owned metadata about the plugins in marketplace.json: how much this vault needs each one, and the scope it is installed at. Claude Code does not read this file - the app's Plugins tab does, because the classification exists nowhere else in machine-readable form (docs/plugins.md states it in prose). `tier` is decided by what breaks without the plugin: `required` = an app feature or an agent launch stops working (workhub's skills are named in the app's own launch prompts; engineering's SessionStart hook is the only reader of the .claude/project-context.json the app writes); `recommended` = nothing breaks but the harness is noticeably worse; `optional` = a matter of taste or tech stack. Deliberately carries no version/description/author: plugin.json is the single source for those (T-0221). Every plugin in marketplace.json must appear here exactly once, and vice versa; src/lib/plugin-catalog.test.ts fails CI when the two drift.

plugins.name: workhub
plugins.summary: Task board, vault knowledge base, schedule/mindmap editing, long-term memory and the app's release procedure. Meaningless outside a vault.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.summary: Development workflow: role-based sub-agents, the commit/PR/ADR/TDD skills, serena/context7 MCP launchers, and the SessionStart hook that is the only reader of the project-context.json the app writes.

plugins.name: claude-tooling
plugins.summary: Extending Claude Code itself. Its SessionStart notice reports outdated plugins across every marketplace - the Plugins tab now answers the same question for this one.

plugins.name: authoring
plugins.summary: Writing something and handing it over: README, CLAUDE.md, release notes, work logs, HTML reports and decks.

plugins.name: agent-ops
plugins.summary: Running agents in a terminal multiplexer (herdr/zellij) and the setup behind it.

plugins.name: zenn
plugins.summary: Zenn tech-blog writing: house style and Zenn-flavoured markdown.

plugins.name: strategy
plugins.summary: Decomposing a strategy handed down from above into your own organization's target states, with an auditor agent.

plugins.name: team-ops
plugins.summary: Team operations on a shared folder as SSoT: knowledge base, backlog and sprints, multi-repo tracking. Needs .claude/team-context.json.

plugins.name: obsidian

plugins.name: persona
